main_text.p: gistratui indicet, qui secus statuunt: Improbamus, inquit, & illos qui auctoritatem in Religione DICIS TANTUM CAUSSA attribuunt Magistratibus &c. dum illos aliud esse nolunt, quam eorum, quae ab Episcopis definiuntur executores. Vide de hac propositione Confessionem Ecclesiarum Gallicarum art. 39. 40. Anglicam art. 37. Belgicam art. 36, Bohemicam art. 16. Calvinum Instit. lib. IV. cap. 11. §. 16. Bullingerum de Episcoporum institutione & functione cap. 1. Petrum Martyrem in 1. Sam. cap. 8. de quo commentario Iosias Simlerus Theologus Tigurinus in praefatione ait: nihil eum continere quod non Orthodoxum sit. Eundem in locis communibus lib. 4. c. 13. & in Appendice locorum communium Quaestione, Regi, Principi, Magistratui, liceatne de Religione statuere? Bucerum lib. 1. de Regno Christi. Ivellum Episcopum Sarisburiensem in Apolog. Ecclesię Anglicanae capp. 9. 10. 11. 12. 13.14.

page.notes: Section mark "§. I." at the top right is not a running head and is left out of the running head. Some words are in small capitals (DICIS TANTUM CAUSSA) and are copied as capitals. Long s is written as s throughout. The printed "Ecclesię" is kept with ę. Printed "Iofias" is written as "Iosias". No catchword or signature is printed.
